candidates.title: Elecbrakes EB2, VM1, ELBC2000
candidates.summary:
View CSAF

Summary

Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to gain control of the brakes of a trailer, modify the firmware, disable the brake lights, modify the brake conditions or disable other critical safety features.

The following versions of Elecbrakes EB2, VM1, ELBC2000 are affected:

  • EB2 <=3.0.4.2.0 (CVE-2026-124281, CVE-2026-125273, CVE-2026-96805)
  • ELBC2000 vers:all/* (CVE-2026-124281, CVE-2026-125273, CVE-2026-96805)
  • VM1 <1.3.4.2.1 (CVE-2026-124281, CVE-2026-125273, CVE-2026-96805)
CVSS Vendor Equipme

candidates.title: ThreatsDay: GPT-6.2 Jailbreak Flaws, BubbleLoader PNG Malware, $500M Ransom Demands + 17 More Stories
candidates.summary: The easiest way to fool someone is to give them something they already expect. A job offer. A message about a service outage. A familiar app. Nothing looks strange at first. And that's the problem. This week's stories show how ordinary things are being used to steal data, spread malware, and get people to hand over access. There's another shift worth watching. AI is making some attacks easier
